sequences.title: hotkeys fall back to the binding they had
API keys fall back to the key they had
compute types follow the compute device
translation engines fall back to the engine a tab had
languages fall back to the entry a slot had
geometry keeps what it had for entries that are not ints
overlay settings are checked entry by entry against what they were
the microphone device is checked against the host chosen before it
a selected model must be on its list once the list is known
run-time state takes its type but is not persisted
